title: Provocative AI Facts Nobody Wants to Say (The Uncomfortable Truths)
content:
# Provocative AI Facts: The Uncomfortable Truths

## Fact #1: AI Isn't Intelligent

It's sophisticated pattern matching. No understanding, no reasoning, no consciousness.

AI imitates intelligence because it learned from intelligent human text. Ask it to reason about something outside training data: It fails.

## Fact #2: AI Hallucinates (And Lies Confidently)

AI generates the next statistically likely token. Sometimes that's false.

It confidently states falsehoods. Users can't distinguish fact from fiction. Never trust AI with critical facts without verification.

## Fact #3: AI Was Trained On Stolen Work

Books (copyrighted), code (licensed), art (copyrighted).

No permission asked. No compensation paid. Copyright lawsuits pending against OpenAI and others.

## Fact #4: AI Reflects Biases In Training Data

Resume screening AI discriminates against women (biased training data). Medical AI is less accurate for darker skin tones (insufficient diverse data). Gender biases everywhere.

Math can't remove bias if data contains it.

## Fact #5: AI Will Displace Some Jobs (The Transition Will Suck)

50-80% of customer service, 20-40% of coding, commodity writing collapse.

New jobs emerge but transition is painful. No policy solutions exist. Society hasn't prepared.

## Fact #6: Scaling Laws Might Hit a Wall

Performance improves with more parameters. But improvements follow logarithmic curve (diminishing returns).

At some point: plateau. We don't know where. Could be closer than we think.

## Fact #7: AI Companies Burn Billions Annually

OpenAI loses $1B+ per year. Most AI startups burn millions quarterly.

No proven business model. Entirely dependent on venture capital.

## Fact #8: We Don't Understand How AI Works

70 billion parameters. We can't explain which parameters do what. Emergent properties appear out of nowhere.

We know scaling works. We don't know why. Safety is completely uncertain.

## Fact #9: AI Will Concentrate Power

GPUs cost billions. Only massive companies can afford infrastructure. Small companies must use big company APIs.

Oligopoly forming. OpenAI, Google, Microsoft dominating.

## Fact #10: We Haven't Solved Alignment

Can't reliably make AI do exactly what we want. Bigger AI = Bigger risk if not aligned.

This is an unsolved computer science problem.

---

## Why This Matters

### For Users
- Don't blindly trust AI
- Verify facts before acting
- Understand limitations
- Be aware of biases

### For Developers
- Know you're building with poorly understood tool
- Understand scaling might plateau
- Understand business model uncertainties
- Plan for failure modes you can't predict

### For Society
- Prepare for job displacement
- Address power consolidation
- Establish AI regulation
- Create policies for creator compensation
- Solve alignment problem
